digest.component_or_area: rebar Jira Data Center reconciler live verification suite
propositions: The epic headline AC—an issue created in DC appears locally and a local edit appears on the DC issue with zero unhandled exceptions—must be proven against a scrubbed copy of the real ticket store rather than an empty instance.

Isolation must be enforced and asserted via a fresh git repo with no remote plus REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=off and no Cloud credentials, and the store copy must be scrubbed of all .bridge_state* binding and snapshot artifacts, verified by enumerating the tree.

The prior run's scanned=0 was misread as an empty local store when it actually counts remote Jira issues; store-copy completeness must be proven by counting local tickets on the filesystem against the fetched tickets branch.

A 28-cell inbound/outbound mutation suite must round-trip each mutation against a named per-mutation oracle, with set_parent's epic case asserted directly against the transport via pytest.raises(NotImplementedError), all passes scoped with --filter-local-ids to avoid mass-creating the store copy.

Pagination is a remote property requiring the suite to observe the server page size and seed 2*observed+1 issues to force three pages, and the inbound assignee cell must positively assert the pass minted a jira-family identity via the registry.

The suite surfaced product defects: phantom outbound field-drift updates from the snapshot differ causing unconvergeable churn, missing DC-transport status-transition routing, and --filter-local-ids failing to match inbound creates by target key.
